translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Pedro
book.title: Pedro Gwenadganse Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Pedro

content: Gwenadgan, bemar-daed na gwagsa-wilubbid
Ar Cristo igi anmar-ular na e-sangi naibigusa, anmar deyob naibiguedsik guagwar gudigumogar-gebed. Ar dule na e-sangi naibiguele, we-a-dule iskued-igar meted,
adi na e-burgwedse, we-napneggi mer dulemar-galagwensuli-nanaedba bar gudiguegar, unnila Bab-Dummad-sogedba nanadii-guegar.

Ar bato unniguar bemar epenne dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad-ibmar-imaked yeer-ito-damaladyob galagwensuli bemar nanadii-gusmalad, deun bemar galagwensuli na e-abgangi bingesur nisadii, ibmar-iskana-imaked-bina sogdii, mungudii, agumakar-iba onodii, mas-gunned-ibagi dogdar gobdii, degine, bab-dummadga-imakleged be-bab-dummadga imakdii bemar gusmargu.
We-dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad geger be-dakmardo, bemar na emaryob wilub-obichaa-dasurmaladba. Galagwensuli eba bemar dasurmarsoggu, bemargi binnasur urwedidimarsundo.

Ar a-dulemar Bab Dummadga bela na e-ibmar-imaksad sogedsegoed, ibiga ede deyob imaksa. We-Bab-Dummad guakwaa maid, dulemar-dula-gudimaladga, degi, dulemar-burgwismaladga igar-itoged, dakega bule-nosa nanasmar-dibeye.
Ar a-ular Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued dulemar-burgwismaladga sogleapmogad, adi amar dulemar-baiganyob sanar sabsur odurdaklemogagar, burbardi Bab Dummadba dula gudigumalagar.
We-napneg-bergued-ibagandi oarmaksad. Degisoggu, nue-binsaed-nikaa be gudii-gusun, degine, nue be ataksun, Bab Dummadse gatik be gorsun.
A-ukine, bela bur-bule na be muchub-muchub sabgumar. Ar dule be sabele, bukidar e-iskudiidgi begi nossuliyob be dakoed.
Na be muchub-muchub gwenadgan be-neggi weligwar-itogedgi be ogabmar.

Bemar-wargwen-wargwen gurgin-burbaled-bemarga-uklesadba na be muchub-muchub bendakmarsun. Bemar Bab Dummadga ibmar nued akwemaladsoggu, Bab-Dummad-nabir-bemargi-binsaedba gurgin-burbaled-bemarga-uksad nue be ebumarsun.

Ar gwenad-wargwen sunmakele, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-maid-sogedba sunmakoed. Ar gwenad-wargwen dule-bendakele, Bab-Dummad-ega-gangued-ukedba bendakoed, adi bela e-ibmar-imakedgi Jesucristoba Bab-Dummad-nug dunguegar. Ar ade Bab-Dummad-e-nug dungued, degi, e-ganguedba bela neg-dakmaid degi-sadeguad egadid. Ar deyobdo.
Gwenadgan Bab-Jesúsba-naid-ular naibi-itoged
Gwenadgan-sabemalad, soogi-wilenaiyob beedse bemar naibi-itogedgi, mer geger be itomalo, ar deyob bemar gumalar-gebed.

Deyob bemar wilealir, bemar weligwar itoge-wilubbid, ar Cristo-wilesadgi bemar wilenaimogad, adi Cristo bela-bela na yeer-daklegedgi wese gannar magaro-danikir, a-Cristoba bemar bela-bela weligwar-itogwichi-gumogagar.

Ar Cristo-nug-ular begi uluarmalar, bemargi nued-binsalesye be itoge-wilubmalad, ar Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-gangued bemargi maid-ular. Ar dulemar-bemargi-urwedimaladdi istar Bab-Jesúsgi sunmakdimalad, ar bemardi Bab-Jesús-nug odummodimalad.

Degisoggu, dule-gindaked-ular, ibmar-atursaed-ular, ibmar-iskana-saed-ular, yogsaar gotebin-gotebin daed-ular, bemar-wargwensaale amar-ibmar-imaked-ular, melle be wilemar. Be wilemalar, bur be wilemar, Cristoba-naid-ular.
Ar be Cristoba-naid-ular be wilemalardi, mer be bingegumar, bur Bab-Dummad-nug be ogannomardo.

Ar ibagan nonisunnad anmar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan wis odurdakleged. Ar anmar-inse weyob odurdaklenaidde, ¿degite, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedba-dulemar-ibmar-imaksasurmalad bulesun be insae? Amar nue-dummad odurdaklemaloed.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi soged:

content.text: ¿amar sunna abonolego be insae? Amar abonolegosurmardo.

content: Degisoggu, bemar-Bab-Dummad-sogedba-wiledimalad, we-Bab-Dummad-be-obinnisad, bela bega ibmar imakedse-dasoggu, a-Bab-Dummadga na be-san-burba ukmarsun. Deginbali, bemar gatik ibmar-nueganbi imakdii nanamarsun.
